key_facts.value_en: 2016 (brand unveiled in Berlin on 2016-10-20; the joint-venture agreement was signed on 2017-08-04)
key_facts.value_zh: 2016 年（品牌 2016 年 10 月 20 日于德国柏林发布；合资协议 2017 年 8 月 4 日签署）

key_facts.value_en: China (operations; the brand was unveiled in Berlin, Germany in 2016)
key_facts.value_zh: 中国（运营主体；品牌 2016 年于德国柏林发布）

key_facts.value_en: Private; a wholly-owned brand of Geely Automobile Holdings (0175.HK) since December 2025, operated under Zeekr Group; originally a joint venture of Geely Auto (50%), Volvo Cars (30%) and Geely Holding (20%)
key_facts.value_zh: 民营；2025 年 12 月起为吉利汽车控股（0175.HK）全资附属品牌，隶属极氪科技集团；原为吉利汽车（50%）、沃尔沃汽车（30%）、吉利控股（20%）的合资公司

key_facts.value_en: Geely Automobile Holdings (0175.HK) via Zeekr Group; Geely Auto is controlled by Geely Holding
key_facts.value_zh: 吉利汽车控股（0175.HK）（经极氪科技集团）；吉利汽车由吉利控股控制

key_facts.value_en: Not separately listed (brand); parent Geely Automobile Holdings is listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (0175.HK)
key_facts.value_zh: 未单独上市（品牌）；母公司吉利汽车控股于港交所上市（0175.HK）

key_facts.value_en: Not separately disclosed (brand-level financials are not reported; see the parent Geely Automobile Holdings research)
key_facts.value_zh: 未单独披露（品牌层面财务数据不单独披露，见母公司吉利汽车控股深度研究）

key_facts.value_en: 350,495 units, +22.8% year on year (the annual report rounds this to +23%); cumulative sales since 2017 exceeded 1.68 million
key_facts.value_zh: 350,495 辆、同比增长 22.8%（年报四舍五入为 23%）；自 2017 年投放以来累计销量超过 168 万辆

key_facts.value_en: Exports exceeded 30,000 units; 195 overseas stores covering 50 countries/regions (Europe: 112 stores in 25 markets; outside Europe: 83 stores in 25 markets)
key_facts.value_zh: 出口超过 3 万辆；海外门店 195 家、覆盖 50 个国家/地区（欧洲 112 家/25 个市场；欧洲以外 83 家/25 个市场）

history.event_en: Geely and Volvo Cars unveil Lynk & Co in Berlin, positioned as a 'born global, open and connected' premium brand for the new generation of open urbanites, with the 01 as its first model.
history.event_zh: 吉利与沃尔沃汽车在德国柏林发布领克品牌，定位「生而全球、开放互联」、面向新一代都市人的全球高端品牌，首款车型为领克 01。

history.event_en: Geely Holding, Geely Automobile Holdings and Volvo Cars sign an agreement at Geely's Hangzhou Bay R&D centre to set up the Lynk & Co joint venture (Geely Auto 50%, Volvo Cars 30%, Geely Holding 20%); a separate Geely-Volvo technology JV (50:50) is formed the same day. An Conghui is named chairman.
history.event_zh: 吉利控股、吉利汽车控股与沃尔沃汽车在吉利杭州湾研发中心签署协议，成立领克汽车合资公司（吉利汽车 50%、沃尔沃汽车 30%、吉利控股 20%）；同日成立吉利-沃尔沃技术合资公司（50:50）。安聪慧出任领克合资公司董事长。

history.event_en: The first model, the 01 compact SUV built on the CMA architecture, goes on sale in China at RMB158,800-202,800 (limited edition RMB220,800).
history.event_zh: 基于 CMA 架构的首款车型、紧凑型 SUV 领克 01 在中国上市，售价 15.88 万—20.28 万元（时间限量版 22.08 万元）。

history.event_en: The 02 compact crossover goes on sale at RMB122,800-192,800, and in October 2018 the 03 compact sedan follows at RMB116,800-151,800, completing the brand's SUV-and-sedan line-up.
history.event_zh: 紧凑型跨界车领克 02 上市，售价 12.28 万—19.28 万元；同年 10 月首款轿车领克 03 上市，售价 11.68 万—15.18 万元，形成「SUV+轿车」产品布局。

history.event_en: Lynk & Co Cyan Racing wins the FIA WTCR teams' title, the first world title in a top-level FIA touring-car championship for a Chinese automotive brand.
history.event_zh: 领克 Cyan Racing 车队夺得 FIA WTCR 房车世界杯年度车队总冠军，成为中国汽车品牌在世界顶级房车赛事中的首个年度总冠军。

history.event_en: The 05 compact coupe SUV is launched at RMB175,800-212,800.
history.event_zh: 紧凑型轿跑 SUV 领克 05 上市，售价 17.58 万—21.28 万元。

history.event_en: Lynk & Co launches its European plan, entering Europe with a membership/subscription model; the 06 subcompact SUV also goes on sale in China the same month at RMB118,600-158,600.
history.event_zh: 领克启动「欧洲计划」，以会员制/订阅制进入欧洲市场；同月小型 SUV 领克 06 在中国上市，售价 11.86 万—15.86 万元。

history.event_en: The 09 mid/large SUV, the first model based on Volvo's SPA architecture, is launched at the brand's fifth-anniversary event (MHEV RMB265,900-320,900; PHEV RMB315,900-370,900).
history.event_zh: 品牌五周年之际，基于沃尔沃 SPA 架构的中大型 SUV 领克 09 上市（MHEV 26.59 万—32.09 万元，PHEV 31.59 万—37.09 万元）。

history.event_en: Lynk & Co Cyan Racing claims its third consecutive WTCR teams' title and a second straight drivers' title, with Yann Ehrlacher winning back-to-back championships.
history.event_zh: 领克 Cyan Racing 车队实现 WTCR 车队三连冠、车手双连冠，车手扬·埃赫拉舍蝉联年度车手总冠军。

history.event_en: The 08 EM-P mid-size plug-in hybrid SUV is launched at RMB208,800-288,000; it is the first model on the CMA Evo architecture and the first to carry the Meizu-developed LYNK Flyme Auto cockpit.
history.event_zh: 中型插电混动 SUV 领克 08 EM-P 上市，售价 20.88 万—28.80 万元；为首款 CMA Evo 架构车型，并首搭魅族 LYNK Flyme Auto 智能座舱。

history.event_en: The 07 EM-P mid-size plug-in hybrid sedan is launched at RMB169,800-189,800 (limited-time from RMB163,800).
history.event_zh: 中型插电混动轿车领克 07 EM-P 上市，售价 16.98 万—18.98 万元（限时 16.38 万元起）。

history.event_en: The Z10, the brand's first battery-electric model, a mid/large sedan on the SEA architecture, is launched at RMB202,800-299,800 (limited-time from RMB196,800).
history.event_zh: 品牌首款纯电车型、基于 SEA 架构的中大型轿车领克 Z10 上市，指导价 20.28 万—29.98 万元（限时 19.68 万元起）。

history.event_en: Geely Holding announces a group restructuring under which Zeekr is to acquire Volvo Cars' 30% and Geely Holding's 20% stakes in Lynk & Co.
history.event_zh: 吉利控股宣布品牌重组，极氪将收购沃尔沃汽车所持领克 30% 股权及吉利控股所持 20% 股权。

history.event_en: Zeekr completes the acquisition of 50% of Lynk & Co and subscribes about RMB367 million of new capital to reach 51%; Zeekr Group is formed, housing the Zeekr and Lynk & Co brands.
history.event_zh: 极氪完成对领克 50% 股权的收购并认购约 3.67 亿元新增资本、最终持股 51%，极氪科技集团成立，旗下运营极氪与领克两个品牌。

history.event_en: The 900 full-size plug-in hybrid flagship SUV is launched on the SPA Evo architecture at a limited-time price of RMB289,900-396,900.
history.event_zh: 基于 SPA Evo 架构的全尺寸插电混动旗舰 SUV 领克 900 上市，限时售价 28.99 万—39.69 万元。

history.event_en: The 10 EM-P mid/large plug-in hybrid sedan is launched at a limited-time price of RMB163,800-201,800, the brand's first model with an NVIDIA Thor assisted-driving chip.
history.event_zh: 中大型插电混动轿车领克 10 EM-P 上市，限时售价 16.38 万—20.18 万元，为品牌首款搭载英伟达 Thor 智驾芯片的车型。

history.event_en: Following Zeekr's privatisation, Lynk & Co becomes a wholly-owned subsidiary of Geely Automobile Holdings (0175.HK).
history.event_zh: 随极氪完成私有化，领克成为吉利汽车控股（0175.HK）的全资附属公司。

history.event_en: The Lynk & Co 10 and 10+, a mid/large battery-electric sedan based on the SEA architecture with a 900V platform and a standard lidar, is launched with guide prices from RMB183,900 to RMB249,900 and limited-time prices from RMB169,900 to RMB235,900.
history.event_zh: 基于 SEA 架构、采用 900V 平台、全系标配激光雷达的中大型纯电轿车领克 10/10+ 上市，官方指导价 18.39 万—24.99 万元、限时售价 16.99 万—23.59 万元。

history.event_en: The 07GT, the brand's first wagon (运动旅行车) with the EM-P hybrid system, is launched in Hangzhou at a guide price of RMB157,800-208,800 and a limited-time price of RMB145,800-196,800.
history.event_zh: 品牌首款旅行车、搭载 EM-P 智能电混的领克 07GT 在杭州上市，指导价 15.78 万—20.88 万元、限时价 14.58 万—19.68 万元。

history.event_en: Geely Automobile Holdings announces that Li Shufu steps down as chairman (effective 2026-08-18) and becomes honorary life chairman; An Conghui succeeds as chairman and Gan Jiayue becomes CEO. The Geely Auto Group sales corporation is also formed, with Fan Junyi appointed general manager of the Lynk & Co sales company.
history.event_zh: 吉利汽车控股宣布李书福辞任董事会主席（2026 年 8 月 18 日生效）、出任终身荣誉主席，安聪慧接任董事会主席、淦家阅任行政总裁；同月吉利汽车集团销售总公司成立，范峻毅出任领克销售公司总经理。

history.event_en: Geely Auto Group and Volvo Cars sign a final agreement under which Volvo Cars becomes the exclusive distributor of Lynk & Co in Europe from January 2027, with no change to the ownership structure.
history.event_zh: 吉利汽车集团与沃尔沃汽车签署最终协议，自 2027 年 1 月起沃尔沃汽车成为领克在欧洲的独家经销商，本次合作不涉及股权架构变更。

history.event_en: The Lynk & Co 20 compact electric SUV (successor to the Z20) is launched in Chengdu with a guide price of RMB123,800-163,800 and a limited-time price of RMB118,800-158,800.
history.event_zh: 紧凑型纯电 SUV 领克 20（Z20 换代车型）在成都上市，官方指导价 12.38 万—16.38 万元、限时专享价 11.88 万—15.88 万元。

brands.role_en: Compact SUV, the brand's first model, built on the CMA architecture; available with combustion and PHEV powertrains.
brands.role_zh: 紧凑型 SUV，品牌首款车型，基于 CMA 架构，提供燃油与插电混动版本。
brands.owner_note_en: Launched 2017-11-28. It was the first model used for the European subscription service from 2020.
brands.owner_note_zh: 2017 年 11 月 28 日上市，自 2020 年起成为欧洲订阅制服务的首款车型。

brands.role_en: Compact crossover/hatchback launched in 2018; the 02 Hatchback remains in the official China combustion line-up, while the '02' name is also used in Europe for the Z20 battery-electric SUV.
brands.role_zh: 2018 年上市的紧凑型跨界车/掀背车；02 Hatchback 仍列于官网中国燃油序列，同时「02」名称在欧洲被用于纯电 SUV Z20。
brands.owner_note_en: Launched 2018-06-28 in China. The 02 Hatchback is still listed in the official combustion range as of October 2026; in Europe the '02' name is applied to the Z20 (sold as the Lynk & Co 02).
brands.owner_note_zh: 2018 年 6 月 28 日在中国上市。截至 2026 年 10 月，02 Hatchback 仍列于官网燃油序列；在欧洲「02」名称用于 Z20（领克 02）。

brands.role_en: Compact sedan and the brand's motorsport base, with the high-performance 03+ and the 03 TCR race car.
brands.role_zh: 紧凑型轿车，也是品牌赛车运动的基础，含高性能 03+ 与 03 TCR 赛车。
brands.owner_note_en: Launched 2018-10-19. A third-generation 03 with the LYNK Flyme Auto cockpit was launched in 2025; the 03 family had accumulated more than 450,000 sales by end-2025.
brands.owner_note_zh: 2018 年 10 月 19 日上市。搭载 LYNK Flyme Auto 的第三代领克 03 于 2025 年上市；截至 2025 年末 03 家族累计销量突破 45 万辆。

brands.role_en: Compact coupe SUV, the brand's first coupe-styled SUV, on the CMA architecture; the current official combustion range lists the 05+ variant.
brands.role_zh: 紧凑型轿跑 SUV，品牌首款轿跑造型 SUV，基于 CMA 架构；官网现行燃油序列列 05+ 版本。

brands.role_en: Subcompact SUV, the brand's entry-level model, offered with combustion, MHEV and PHEV powertrains; the current range lists the 06 Relive.
brands.role_zh: 小型 SUV，品牌入门车型，提供燃油、轻混与插电混动版本；现行序列列 06 Relive。
brands.owner_note_en: Launched 2020-09-06 at the brand's Chengdu plant.
brands.owner_note_zh: 2020 年 9 月 6 日上市，在品牌成都工厂生产。

brands.role_en: Mid-size plug-in hybrid sedan on the CMA Evo architecture, part of the EM-P hybrid family.
brands.role_zh: 基于 CMA Evo 架构的中型插电混动轿车，属 EM-P 电混家族。
brands.owner_note_en: Launched 2024-05-17. Together with the 08 EM-P it formed the 'EM-P twin stars'; the pair had accumulated more than 200,000 sales by end-2025.
brands.owner_note_zh: 2024 年 5 月 17 日上市。与 08 EM-P 组成「EM-P 双子星」，截至 2025 年末两者累计销量突破 20 万辆。

brands.role_en: The brand's first wagon (sport-touring), powered by the EM-P hybrid system, positioned as a 'tech hybrid sport wagon'.
brands.role_zh: 品牌首款旅行车，搭载 EM-P 智能电混系统，定位「科技智混运动旅行车」。
brands.owner_note_en: Launched 2026-07-23 in Hangzhou; pre-sale orders exceeded 35,000 in 24 days, orders passed 10,000 within 27 minutes of launch, and it reached 10,000 deliveries on 2026-09-20.
brands.owner_note_zh: 2026 年 7 月 23 日在杭州上市；预售 24 天订单超 3.5 万单，上市 27 分钟大定破万，2026 年 9 月 20 日达成万台交付。

brands.role_en: Mid-size plug-in hybrid SUV, the first model on the CMA Evo architecture and the first to carry the Meizu-developed LYNK Flyme Auto cockpit.
brands.role_zh: 中型插电混动 SUV，首款 CMA Evo 架构车型，首搭魅族 LYNK Flyme Auto 智能座舱。
brands.owner_note_en: Launched 2023-09-08. By end-2025 the 08 EM-P had been launched in 31 overseas markets, according to the brand.
brands.owner_note_zh: 2023 年 9 月 8 日上市。据品牌披露，截至 2025 年末 08 EM-P 已进入 31 个海外市场。

brands.role_en: Mid/large SUV, the first model based on Volvo's SPA architecture; available as MHEV and PHEV.
brands.role_zh: 中大型 SUV，首款基于沃尔沃 SPA 架构的车型，提供轻混与插电混动版本。
brands.owner_note_en: Launched 2021-10-20. 09 MHEV and 09 EM-P variants remain in the current line-up.
brands.owner_note_zh: 2021 年 10 月 20 日上市。09 MHEV 与 09 EM-P 车型仍在当前产品序列中销售。

brands.role_en: Full-size six-seat plug-in hybrid flagship SUV on the SPA Evo architecture.
brands.role_zh: 基于 SPA Evo 架构的全尺寸六座插电混动旗舰 SUV。
brands.owner_note_en: Launched 2025-04-28. It sold over 50,000 units within six months of launch, according to the brand.
brands.owner_note_zh: 2025 年 4 月 28 日上市。据品牌披露，上市 6 个月销量突破 5 万辆。

brands.role_en: Mid/large plug-in hybrid sedan on the CMA Evo platform, the brand's first model with an NVIDIA Thor assisted-driving chip.
brands.role_zh: 基于 CMA Evo 平台的中大型插电混动轿车，品牌首款搭载英伟达 Thor 智驾芯片的车型。
brands.owner_note_en: Launched 2025-09-08. It sold over 20,000 units within three months of launch, according to the brand.
brands.owner_note_zh: 2025 年 9 月 8 日上市。据品牌披露，上市 3 个月销量超 2 万辆。

brands.role_en: Mid/large battery-electric sedan on the SEA architecture with a 900V platform and a standard lidar; the 10+ is the dual-motor high-performance version.
brands.role_zh: 基于 SEA 架构、采用 900V 平台、全系标配激光雷达的中大型纯电轿车；10+ 为双电机高性能版。
brands.owner_note_en: Launched 2026-05-29; the 816km CLTC variant uses a 95 kWh battery and the 701km variant a 77 kWh battery.
brands.owner_note_zh: 2026 年 5 月 29 日上市；CLTC 续航 816 公里的版本搭载 95 度电池、701 公里版本搭载 77 度电池。

brands.role_en: Mid/large battery-electric sedan, the brand's first BEV, built on Geely's SEA architecture; it has been succeeded in the official line-up by the 10/10+.
brands.role_zh: 中大型纯电轿车，品牌首款纯电车型，基于吉利 SEA 架构；已在官网序列由 10/10+ 接替。
brands.owner_note_en: Launched 2024-09-05. As of October 2026 it is no longer listed in the official battery-electric range.
brands.owner_note_zh: 2024 年 9 月 5 日上市。截至 2026 年 10 月已不再列于官网纯电序列。

brands.role_en: Compact battery-electric SUV on the SEA architecture; sold in Europe as the Lynk & Co 02. In China it has been succeeded by the Lynk & Co 20.
brands.role_zh: 基于 SEA 架构的紧凑型纯电 SUV；在欧洲以领克 02 名称销售，在中国市场由领克 20 接替。
brands.owner_note_en: Debuted in Milan in October 2024 and launched in China on 2024-12-22; the '02' name remains in use in Europe, while China's official battery-electric range no longer lists the Z20.
brands.owner_note_zh: 2024 年 10 月在米兰首发，2024 年 12 月 22 日在中国上市；「02」名称在欧洲仍在使用，而中国官网纯电序列已不再单列 Z20。

brands.role_en: Compact battery-electric SUV (successor to the Z20), with an 800V platform, 6C fast charging and a lidar as standard.
brands.role_zh: 紧凑型纯电 SUV（Z20 换代车型），800V 平台、6C 快充与激光雷达全系标配。
brands.owner_note_en: Launched 2026-09-28 in Chengdu; the brand reported 14,663 firm orders within one hour of launch.
brands.owner_note_zh: 2026 年 9 月 28 日在成都上市；据品牌披露，上市一小时内大定突破 14,663 台。

financials.standard: Not separately reported (brand); parent Geely Automobile Holdings reports under HKFRS (consistent with IFRS)
financials.note_en: Lynk & Co has never been separately listed and does not publish standalone financial statements, so no revenue, gross margin or net profit is disclosed at brand level, and no financial table is presented here. Because there are no standalone brand accounts, there is no profit-attributable-to-owners-of-the-parent figure to report; that attribution exists only at the parent level. Its results are consolidated into Geely Automobile Holdings Limited (0175.HK, Hong Kong Stock Exchange), which reports under Hong Kong Financial Reporting Standards (HKFRS, consistent with IFRS); Lynk & Co became a wholly-owned subsidiary of Geely Auto in December 2025 after Zeekr's privatisation. The 2025 annual report records that Lynk & Co sold 350,495 vehicles in 2025 (up 23% year on year after rounding; the brand's own release says +22.8%), with new-energy-vehicle sales up 36% to 228,000 units and a 65% NEV share, and that the brand served customers through 583 channel outlets in China. For group financials see the Geely Automobile Holdings research (geely). This page does not constitute any trading recommendation.
financials.note_zh: 领克从未单独上市，亦不单独披露财务报表，品牌层面的营收、毛利率与净利润均未公开，故本表为空。因不存在品牌层面的独立报表，也就不存在「归属于母公司股东/普通股股东」的净利润口径——该口径仅适用于母公司吉利汽车控股的合并报表。领克业绩并入母公司吉利汽车控股有限公司（0175.HK，港交所）合并报表，母公司按香港财务报告准则（HKFRS，与 IFRS 一致）编制；2025 年 12 月极氪私有化完成后，领克成为吉利汽车的全资附属公司。据 2025 年年报，领克 2025 年销量 350,495 辆（同比增长 23%，为四舍五入值；品牌官方口径为 +22.8%），其中新能源汽车销量同比增长 36% 至 22.8 万辆、新能源占比 65%，并于中国通过 583 家渠道网点服务客户。集团财务数据见吉利汽车控股深度研究（geely）。本页不构成任何交易推荐。

overview.en:
Lynk & Co (领克) is a premium automotive brand incubated within the Geely–Volvo Cars partnership and owned by Geely Automobile Holdings (0175.HK). Unveiled in Berlin on 20 October 2016 with a 'born global, open and connected' positioning aimed at urban, younger users, it launched its first model, the 01 compact SUV, in China in November 2017 and now spans combustion, EM-P plug-in hybrid and battery-electric models. [s42][s2][s4]

In February 2025 Zeekr completed the acquisition of 50% of Lynk & Co and subscribed about RMB367 million of new capital to reach 51%, forming Zeekr Group; after Zeekr's privatisation in December 2025, Lynk & Co became a wholly-owned subsidiary of Geely Automobile Holdings. In 2025 the brand sold 350,495 vehicles, up 22.8% year on year (the annual report rounds this to 23%), with new-energy vehicles reaching 65% of sales and cumulative sales since 2017 exceeding 1.68 million. Lynk & Co is not separately listed and does not disclose standalone financials. [s9][s2][s1]

The brand shares Geely–Volvo modular architectures (CMA/CMA Evo, SPA/SPA Evo and SEA) and has built a 'trendy, sporty, personal' identity through motorsport and its user community. In September 2026 Geely Auto Group and Volvo Cars signed a final agreement making Volvo Cars the exclusive distributor of Lynk & Co in Europe from January 2027, a step the brand says will shift its European business to a more scalable retail model. [s4][s8][s3]
overview.zh:
领克（Lynk & Co）是吉利汽车控股有限公司（0175.HK）旗下、由吉利与沃尔沃汽车合作孵化的高端汽车品牌，2016 年 10 月 20 日在德国柏林发布，定位「生而全球、开放互联」，面向都市年轻用户。首款车型紧凑型 SUV 领克 01 于 2017 年 11 月在中国上市，此后逐步形成燃油、EM-P 插电混动与纯电覆盖的产品矩阵。 [s42][s2][s4]

2025 年 2 月，极氪完成对领克 50% 股权的收购并认购约 3.67 亿元新增资本、最终持股 51%，组建极氪科技集团；2025 年 12 月极氪私有化完成后，领克成为吉利汽车控股的全资附属公司。2025 年领克销量 350,495 辆、同比增长 22.8%（年报四舍五入为 23%），新能源汽车占比升至 65%，自 2017 年以来累计销量超过 168 万辆；领克未单独上市，亦不单独披露财务数据。 [s9][s2][s1]

品牌与沃尔沃共享 CMA/CMA Evo、SPA/SPA Evo 与 SEA 等模块化架构与动力、零部件体系，并以赛车运动与用户社群构建「潮流、运动、个性」标签。2026 年 9 月，吉利汽车集团与沃尔沃汽车签署最终协议，自 2027 年 1 月起沃尔沃将成为领克在欧洲的独家经销商，品牌称将借此向更具扩展性和规模化的欧洲零售模式转型。 [s4][s8][s3]

current.en:
Business and product structure

Lynk & Co sits inside Zeekr Group alongside Zeekr. Under the division of labour stated in February 2025, Zeekr moves upmarket (above RMB 300,000) while Lynk & Co broadens its reach (around RMB 200,000), with small cars focusing on pure electric and mid-to-large cars on hybrid. As of October 2026 the official line-up comprises combustion models (01, 02 Hatchback, 03, 03+, 05+, 06 Relive, 09 MHEV), EM-P plug-in hybrids (07 EM-P, 07GT, 08 EM-P, 09 EM-P, 900, 10 EM-P) and battery-electric models (10, 10+, 20). The earlier Z10 and Z20 are no longer listed in the official battery-electric range, having been succeeded by the 10/10+ and the 20 respectively. [s9][s34]

Sales reached 285,441 units in 2024, up about 30% year on year, and 350,495 in 2025, up 22.8%; in 2025 new-energy sales rose 36% to 228,000 units, lifting the NEV share to 65%, and December 2025 set a monthly record of 33,751 units. In the first half of 2026 Lynk & Co sold about 144,000 units, down 6% year on year, a slower pace than Zeekr's roughly 178,000 units (+97%). According to the brand, its 2025 weighted-average transaction price exceeded RMB 200,000, with the EM-P family averaging RMB 254,200. [s7][s1][s2][s14][s43]

Technology and platforms

Lynk & Co is built on Geely–Volvo modular architectures: CMA (01, 02, 03, 05) and CMA Evo (07, 08, 10 EM-P), Volvo's SPA (09) and SPA Evo (900), and Geely's SEA electric architecture (Z10, Z20, 10/10+, 20). Its electrification stack centres on the EM-P plug-in hybrid system, the cockpit on the Meizu-developed LYNK Flyme Auto, and assisted driving on the group's Qianli Haohan (千里浩瀚) system. The 2026 Lynk & Co 20 makes an 800V platform, 6C fast charging and a lidar standard across the range; the Lynk & Co 10 uses a 900V architecture, with the 95 kWh variant offering up to 816 km CLTC and the 77 kWh variant 701 km. [s4][s18][s26][s35]

Plants and channels

Lynk & Co models are built across Geely's plant network. The 01 was produced at the Taizhou Luqiao plant alongside Volvo models, while later models are made at Zhangjiakou, Yuyao and Chengdu. The Zhangjiakou plant, a Geely–Volvo flagship base, can produce up to 300,000 units a year and mixes combustion and battery-electric production (including the 03 and Volvo's EX30). The Chengdu plant was built specifically for the 06 to Volvo standards, with a planned annual capacity of 300,000 units. At end-2025 the brand served customers through 583 channel outlets in China. [s4][s36][s21][s2]

Overseas business

Overseas, the brand entered Europe in 2020 with a membership/subscription model and later stopped taking new subscriptions as it shifted to a retail model. In 2025 it exported more than 30,000 vehicles and by end-2025 had 195 overseas stores covering 50 countries/regions (112 in Europe across 25 markets; 83 outside Europe across 25 markets). By mid-2026 overseas sales had already exceeded the whole of 2025, and by July 2026 the brand covered 55 overseas countries/regions with 249 stores; according to Xinhua Finance it had more than 140 sales outlets in Europe as of August 2026. The 08 EM-P has been launched in 31 markets and, according to the brand, was Europe's first premium plug-in hybrid with a WLTP pure-electric range over 200 km. [s23][s2][s3][s33][s1]
current.zh:
业务与产品结构

领克与极氪同属极氪科技集团。按集团 2025 年 2 月的表述，极氪「向上」主攻 30 万元以上、领克「向宽」覆盖 20 万元上下，小型车聚焦纯电、中大型车聚焦混动。截至 2026 年 10 月，官网在售序列为：燃油（01、02 Hatchback、03、03+、05+、06 Relive、09 MHEV）、EM-P 插电混动（07 EM-P、07GT、08 EM-P、09 EM-P、900、10 EM-P）与纯电（10、10+、20）。此前的 Z10、Z20 已不再列于官网纯电序列，分别由 10/10+ 与 20 接替。 [s9][s34]

销量方面，2024 年品牌全球销量 285,441 辆、同比增长约 30%；2025 年增至 350,495 辆、同比增长 22.8%，其中新能源汽车销量同比增长 36% 至 22.8 万辆、占比 65%，2025 年 12 月单月销量 33,751 台、创历史新高。2026 年上半年领克销量约 14.4 万辆、同比下降 6%，弱于集团内极氪约 17.8 万辆（同比增长 97%）。据品牌披露，2025 年其加权平均成交价突破 20 万元，EM-P 家族加权平均成交价达 25.42 万元。 [s7][s1][s2][s14][s43]

技术与平台

领克基于吉利-沃尔沃模块化架构造车：CMA（01、02、03、05）与 CMA Evo（07、08、10 EM-P）、沃尔沃 SPA（09）与 SPA Evo（900）、吉利 SEA 浩瀚纯电架构（Z10、Z20、10/10+、20）。电动化以 EM-P 插电混动系统为核心，座舱采用与魅族合作开发的 LYNK Flyme Auto 系统，辅助驾驶接入集团千里浩瀚体系。2026 年上市的领克 20 将 800V 高压平台、6C 快充与激光雷达列为全系标配；领克 10 采用 900V 架构，95 度电版本 CLTC 最高续航 816 公里、77 度电版本 701 公里。 [s4][s18][s26][s35]

工厂与渠道

领克车型在吉利体系多座工厂生产：领克 01 早期在台州路桥工厂与沃尔沃车型共线生产，后续车型在张家口、余姚、成都等基地制造。张家口工厂是吉利-沃尔沃联合打造的标杆基地，年产能可达 30 万辆，实现燃油与纯电混线生产（含领克 03 与沃尔沃 EX30）。成都工厂系为领克 06 专门建设、按沃尔沃标准、规划年产能 30 万辆。截至 2025 年末，品牌在中国通过 583 家渠道网点服务客户。 [s4][s36][s21][s2]

海外业务

海外方面，领克 2020 年以会员制/订阅制进入欧洲，其后逐步转向零售模式并停止接受新订阅。2025 年出口超 3 万辆，截至 2025 年末拥有 195 家海外门店、覆盖 50 个国家/地区（欧洲 112 家/25 个市场，欧洲以外 83 家/25 个市场）。2026 年上半年海外销量已超越 2025 全年，截至 2026 年 7 月覆盖海外 55 个国家/地区、海外门店达 249 家；据新华财经报道，截至 2026 年 8 月领克在欧洲拥有超 140 个销售网点。据品牌披露，领克 08 EM-P 已进入 31 个市场，是欧洲首款 WLTP 工况纯电续航突破 200 公里的高端插电混动车型。 [s23][s2][s3][s33][s1]

leadership.en:
Brand origin

Lynk & Co was created within the Geely–Volvo partnership initiated by Geely Holding founder Li Shufu. When the joint venture was formed in 2017, An Conghui, then president and CEO of Geely Auto Group, became its chairman, with Volvo Cars president and CEO Håkan Samuelsson, Li Donghui and Feng Qingfeng among the directors. [s22]

Current management (as of 2026-10-29)

  • An Conghui (安聪慧) — chairman of Geely Automobile Holdings (0175.HK) since 18 August 2026, and CEO of Zeekr Group. He joined Geely in 1996, led the CMA/SEA architecture programmes, incubated the Lynk & Co and Zeekr brands, and was named chairman of the Lynk & Co joint venture when it was formed in 2017. [s30][s9]
  • Gan Jiayue (淦家阅) — CEO of Geely Automobile Holdings since 18 August 2026 and CEO of Geely Auto Group. [s30]
  • Liu Xiangyang (刘向阳) — vice-president of Zeekr Group and CEO of the Lynk & Co brand since February 2025. He worked at Haier (including as general manager of Qingdao Haier Refrigerator) before joining Geely in September 2007, and previously served as a vice-president of Geely Holding and a senior vice-president of Geely Auto Group. [s12][s9]
  • Lin Jie (林杰) — senior vice-president of Geely Auto Group, general manager of the Geely Auto Group sales corporation and general manager of the Zeekr sales company since August 2026; from 2018 he served as general manager of the Lynk & Co sales company. [s25][s41]
  • Fan Junyi (范峻毅) — executive deputy general manager of the Geely Auto Group sales corporation and general manager of the Lynk & Co sales company since August 2026, also overseeing the Galaxy sales company; he joined Geely in 2003 and had been general manager of the Geely Auto sales company since 2022. [s25][s31]
  • Kang Guowang (康国旺) — head of the Lynk & Co vehicle research institute (per an August–September 2026 report). [s26]
  • Yuan Jing (袁璟) — CFO of Zeekr Group; Guan Haitao (关海涛) — CBO of Zeekr Group (roles announced in February 2025). [s9]

Ownership and governance

At formation the Lynk & Co joint venture was held by Geely Auto (50%), Volvo Cars (30%) and Geely Holding (20%). After the 2025 integration and Zeekr's privatisation in December 2025, Lynk & Co became a wholly-owned subsidiary of Geely Automobile Holdings (0175.HK), which is in turn controlled by Geely Holding; the brand has no separate controlling-shareholder designation beyond this ownership chain. [s22][s2][s9]
leadership.zh:
品牌渊源

领克诞生于吉利控股创始人李书福推动的吉利-沃尔沃合作框架。2017 年合资公司成立时，吉利汽车集团总裁兼 CEO 安聪慧出任领克合资公司董事长，董事会成员还包括沃尔沃汽车总裁兼 CEO 汉肯·塞缪尔森、李东辉、冯擎峰等。 [s22]

现任核心管理层（截至 2026-10-29）

  • 安聪慧——吉利汽车控股有限公司（0175.HK）董事会主席（2026 年 8 月 18 日起），极氪科技集团 CEO。1996 年加入吉利，主导 CMA/SEA 架构研发，孵化领克、极氪两大品牌，2017 年合资公司成立时出任领克合资公司董事长。 [s30][s9]
  • 淦家阅——吉利汽车控股有限公司行政总裁（2026 年 8 月 18 日起），吉利汽车集团 CEO。 [s30]
  • 刘向阳——极氪科技集团副总裁、领克品牌 CEO（2025 年 2 月起）。早年任职海尔（含青岛海尔电冰箱股份有限公司总经理），2007 年 9 月加入吉利，曾任吉利控股副总裁、吉利汽车集团高级副总裁。 [s12][s9]
  • 林杰——吉利汽车集团高级副总裁、销售总公司总经理兼极氪销售公司总经理（2026 年 8 月起）；2018 年起曾任领克销售公司总经理。 [s25][s41]
  • 范峻毅——吉利汽车集团销售总公司常务副总经理兼领克销售公司总经理（2026 年 8 月起），并分管银河销售公司；2003 年加入吉利，2022 年起任吉利汽车销售公司总经理。 [s25][s31]
  • 康国旺——领克整车研究院院长（据 2026 年 9 月报道）。 [s26]
  • 袁璟——极氪科技集团 CFO，关海涛——极氪科技集团 CBO（均为 2025 年 2 月公布的职务）。 [s9]

股权与治理

成立之初，领克合资公司由吉利汽车持股 50%、沃尔沃汽车持股 30%、吉利控股持股 20%。2025 年整合并完成极氪私有化后，领克于 2025 年 12 月成为吉利汽车控股（0175.HK）的全资附属公司，吉利汽车控股由吉利控股控制；品牌层面没有在此持股链条之外的独立「实际控制人」认定。 [s22][s2][s9]

competition.en:
Lynk & Co competes in China's mid-to-premium segment, spanning compact sedans and SUVs through to full-size SUVs. Its stated advantages are the Geely–Volvo architectures (CMA/SPA/SEA), a vertically integrated supply chain, and a distinctive design and motorsport identity built on successive WTCR/TCR titles. [s26][s8]

Our judgment: within its segments, the 03/07/08/09 compete against mainstream joint-venture models such as the Honda Accord and Toyota Camry and domestic new-energy rivals; the Z10, 10/10+ and 20 electric models face competitors such as the Xiaomi SU7, XPeng MONA and BYD Yuan Plus; and the 900 and 09 move into the large-SUV space contested by the Li Auto L-series and BYD Denza. Lynk & Co has genuine premium pricing power for a domestic brand — a 2025 weighted-average transaction price above RMB 200,000 and an EM-P average of RMB 254,200 — but its scale is moderate and, unlike Zeekr, it does not report standalone financials, so profitability cannot be assessed at brand level. First-half 2026 sales of about 144,000 units were down 6% year on year, a slower pace than Zeekr's +97%, suggesting pressure from the shift of its combustion base toward hybrids and from domestic price competition. Its motorsport titles and 'trendy, sporty' positioning give it differentiation among domestic marques, though that has not yet fully converted into volume growth. This is our assessment, based on the disclosed sales and pricing data. [s1][s14]
competition.zh:
领克在中国中高端市场参与竞争，产品覆盖紧凑型轿车、SUV 直至全尺寸 SUV。其公开优势在于吉利-沃尔沃架构（CMA/SPA/SEA）、垂直整合的供应链，以及依托连续多项 WTCR/TCR 冠军建立的鲜明设计与赛车运动标签。 [s26][s8]

我们的判断：在其细分市场中，03/07/08/09 面对本田雅阁、丰田凯美瑞等主流合资车型及本土新能源竞品，Z10、10/10+、20 等纯电车型面对小米 SU7、小鹏 MONA、比亚迪元 PLUS 等竞品，900 与 09 则进入理想 L 系列、比亚迪腾势等所处的大型 SUV 市场。作为本土品牌，领克具备真实的高端定价能力——2025 年加权平均成交价突破 20 万元、EM-P 家族达 25.42 万元；但其规模处于中等水平，且不单独披露财务数据，品牌层面的盈利能力无法单独评估。2026 年上半年领克销量约 14.4 万辆、同比下滑 6%，弱于集团内极氪（+97%），显示其面临燃油基盘向混动切换与国内价格竞争的双重压力。另一方面，凭借 WTCR/TCR 多项世界冠军与「潮流、运动」标签，领克在本土品牌中拥有一定品牌溢价与差异化基础，但该溢价尚未完全转化为规模增长。以上为我们的判断，依据为前述披露的销量与价格数据。 [s1][s14]

outlook.en:
Company plans. Within Zeekr Group, Lynk & Co is positioned to broaden its reach while Zeekr moves upmarket, with small cars focusing on pure electric and mid-to-large cars on hybrid. At the August 2026 interim results, the group said Lynk & Co would use the 07GT and the new Z20 (subsequently launched as the 20) to open up higher-end segments in the second half — a plan stated at that point, not a result. Under the 10 September 2026 agreement, Volvo Cars becomes the exclusive European distributor from January 2027, a shift to a more scalable retail model with no change to the ownership structure. At the outset of the 2025 integration Zeekr Group set a 2025 target of 390,000 units for Lynk & Co within a group target of 710,000; actual 2025 sales were about 350,000. These are stated plans and targets, not achieved results. [s39][s3][s9]

Our analysis. Lynk & Co's 22.8% growth in 2025 was driven by new EM-P models (900 and 10 EM-P) rather than its legacy combustion base, and first-half 2026 volume slipped 6% year on year, showing that the combustion base is shrinking faster than the hybrid/BEV ramp is filling the gap. Sustained growth therefore depends on the continued ramp of the 07GT, 10/10+ and 20, on stabilising the combustion base through refreshes such as the third-generation 03, and on whether the Volvo European retail network converts into higher volume from 2027. The main alternatives are a prolonged domestic price war, EU countervailing duties on China-built battery-electric vehicles, the pace of Zeekr-integration synergies, and the concentration of growth in a few high-price models. This is our judgment and does not predict any share price. [s14][s26][s13]
outlook.zh:
公司公开规划。在极氪科技集团内，领克定位「向宽」拓展，小型车聚焦纯电、中大型车聚焦混动。2026 年 8 月中报时点，集团表示下半年领克将以 07GT、全新 Z20（后以「领克 20」名称上市）等新品开拓高端细分市场——此为当时计划表述，并非已实现结果。按 2026 年 9 月 10 日签署的协议，自 2027 年 1 月起沃尔沃成为领克在欧洲的独家经销商，领克称将借此向更具扩展性和规模化的零售模式转型，且不涉及股权变更。在 2025 年整合之初，极氪科技集团曾将领克 2025 年销量目标定为 39 万辆（集团 71 万辆），当年领克实际销量约 35 万辆。以上为公司目标与计划表述，并非已实现结果。 [s39][s3][s9]

我们的分析。领克 2025 年 22.8% 的增长主要由 900、10 EM-P 等 EM-P 新品拉动，而非既有燃油基盘；2026 年上半年销量同比下滑 6%，显示燃油基盘收缩的速度快于混动/纯电新品放量填补的速度。持续增长因此取决于 07GT、10/10+、领克 20 等新品继续放量、以第三代 03 等改款稳住燃油基盘，以及 2027 年起沃尔沃欧洲零售网络能否转化为更高销量。主要变数在于国内价格战延续、欧盟对中国产纯电动车的反补贴关税、极氪整合协同兑现进度，以及增长集中于少数高价车型带来的波动风险。以上为我们的判断，不构成任何股价预测。 [s14][s26][s13]

risks.en:
• Slowing momentum. Lynk & Co's first-half 2026 sales of about 144,000 units were down 6% year on year, a slower pace than Zeekr, indicating pressure during the brand's transition. [s14]
  • Price competition. The mid-to-premium segment is contested by joint-venture brands cutting prices and by domestic new-energy rivals, which can pressure transaction prices and margins. [s17]
  • Tariff exposure. Lynk & Co exports battery-electric models; China-built BEVs face additional EU countervailing duties, raising the cost of its European exports. [s13]
  • European-model transition. The subscription service stopped taking new customers in 2025; the shift to Volvo-distributed retail depends on the Volvo network for scale and carries execution risk. [s2]
  • Integration execution. Folding Lynk & Co and Zeekr into one group requires product, R&D and channel coordination, and the group has said each brand's product count was cut by about 20%, which carries execution risk. [s9]
  • Concentration on high-price models. 2025 growth was driven mainly by a few high-price EM-P models (900, 10 EM-P), raising dependence on individual nameplates. [s1]
  • No standalone disclosure. Lynk & Co does not report standalone financials, so external observers cannot directly assess brand-level profitability. [s2]
risks.zh:
• 增长动能放缓。领克 2026 年上半年销量约 14.4 万辆、同比下滑 6%，弱于集团内极氪等增长品牌，品牌切换期面临压力。 [s14]
  • 价格竞争。中高端市场面临合资品牌降价与本土新能源品牌的双重挤压，可能对成交价与利润形成压力。 [s17]
  • 关税风险。领克出口纯电车型，中国产纯电动车在欧盟面临额外反补贴关税，推高其欧洲出口成本。 [s13]
  • 欧洲模式切换。订阅制已于 2025 年停止接受新订阅，转向沃尔沃经销零售后，规模化依赖沃尔沃网络，存在执行与协同风险。 [s2]
  • 整合执行风险。领克与极氪并入同一集团需在产品、研发、渠道协同，集团称两个品牌产品数量各削减约 20%，存在执行风险。 [s9]
  • 高端车型集中度。2025 年增长主要由 900、10 EM-P 等少数高价车型拉动，品牌对个别车型的依赖度上升。 [s1]
  • 无独立披露。领克不单独披露财务数据，外部观察者难以直接评估品牌层面的盈利或亏损。 [s2]
